shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat (typed bridges, clean signatures); Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only, zero typerefs).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only. Modern Suite parity contract for any styled UI.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x, no power link, rotatable edge-hugging), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend shaft gizmos, ground car holds both links, two-hop rides auto-continue).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x settings slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses the far side, no refund; reinstall spawns fresh). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops (rock roofs immune).
- All consumers resolve links via CounterpartTowards(map); stair jobs carry their exit in targetC.
- Mounted riders (Giddy-Up) are blocked from stairs jobs with a dismount message (job start + transfer backstop); mounts carrying riders are skipped by the pet follow pull.

## Sky surface model (reworked 2026-07-19 after playtest)
- Three owned terrains: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable), AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel rooftop, walk/build, 512px ridged-panel texture), AB_RockRoofSurface (natural rock roof top, walk/build, mottled stone texture).
- Mapping rule everywhere (genstep, live events, reconciliation): no roof below = open air; constructed roof below = rooftop; natural roof below = rock roof. The natural thin-roof overhang strip at mountain edges is rock roof, which seals the former see-through slivers under the vanilla rock edge sprites.
- Three sync layers: (1) genstep snapshot at generation; (2) live ground RoofChanged events; (3) self-healing - subscription RETRY from MapComponentTick every 250t until it lands (FinalizeInit's attempt could bail silently and never retry - the playtest see-through bug), plus a bounded ReconcileRooftops sweep at FinalizeInit and every 2000t per sky map (~sub-ms) that converges terrain from the live roof grid even if events misfire.
- Ore generation: ABOreGen scatters mineable lumps (weighted by vanilla mineableScatterCommonality, so modded ores participate) into the basement fill and the sky mountain wall cells, 6 lumps/10k cells, replacing only natural non-resource rock (stairs/landings/existing lumps untouched). GridShapeMaker.IrregularLump shapes.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- See-below renderer: whitelisted layers incl. water depth, air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45), silhouettes suppressed, ceiling hints, far clip 70.
- Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels; surface sync sole driver.
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch WorkGiver + demand pull (construction, bill shortfalls with aggregated alternatives, patient/prisoner meals) + export pinning + deterministic carried-cargo delivery after transfer.
- Build designator stuff picker is column-aware: pattern-guarded transpiler swaps the ListerThings.ThingsOfDef gate in Designator_Build.ProcessInput for ColumnThingsOfDef (local first, then directly linked levels). ResourceCounter augmentation feeds the same picker's def source.
- Needs: rest routes to owned bed anywhere in column (two-hop) or free bed on linked level; food redirect for colonists and eligible pets.
- Medical/prisoners: cross-level rescue WorkGiver + capture float order via CarriedIntent continuations.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (+ ghouls in Schedule only, Animals tab patched separately, Fluffy Animal Tab covered via its RecachePawns); colonist bar groups ordered sky/surface/basement per column; level view buttons in the vanilla global controls row (Declutter UI suppression bypassed); camera preserves precise sub-cell position and zoom; beds alert aggregates the column.
- Power/pipes/climate bridge per link (elevator second link included).
- Cross-map ordered work: ABPendingOrders stashes an action + target map, replayed by StairTransfer on arrival.

## Performance architecture (2026-07-19 optimization pass)
- ABGuard kill switches are plain bool objects (ABGuardSwitch): hot gates pay one field read.
- LevelComp.AnySkyLevels: game-weakref-keyed counter; OutdoorTemp/SeasonalTemp postfixes early out on static reads when no sky level exists.
- CrossLevelWork.NearestUsableStairsCached: per-tick (pawn, targetMap) memo incl. negative results; the HaulableEver scanner pays the region search twice per pawn-scan instead of per item.
- Shared helpers: TryResolveStairs / MakeStairsJob / TryStairsJobToward + ABVirtualPosition.WithPawnAt (cold paths); CrossLevelHaul.Check keeps its hand-written swap.
- Small caches: Building_ABStairs.Ext, static meal array, cached level-button tooltips, shared ABIcons.
- Event-driven elsewhere; recurring costs: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t (sky maps only). Zero recurring cost with no levels built.

## Compat
- DBH water + VEF PipeSystem equalization bridges (live-verified). Reverse Commands cross-level float menu (reflection-only). Fluffy Animal Tab RecachePawns append. Declutter UI SuppressExternal bypass for level buttons. Giddy-Up mounted-rider stairs block (def-based). About.xml incompatibleWith telardo.MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1. RimThreaded unsupported (documented). Foreign pocket maps read as standalone level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/ledge rock on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air (cosmetic); bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples counted as singles in beds alert; Reverse Commands scope is directly linked levels only; restaurants do not span levels; stuff picker sees directly linked levels only.
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE. Optimization + compat pass DONE. Playtest round 2 fixes DONE (2026-07-19): corrugated rooftop + rock roof textures, natural-roof strip sealing, subscription retry + periodic reconcile (root cause of persistent see-through), column stuff picker, basement/sky ore generation. Pending relaunch verification (fresh map required for genstep/ore changes).
- Next: T5 publishing prep (field manual incl. RimThreaded note + roof-building explainer, Steam description, dependency audit, publish-hold, final regression with and without companions).
- Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
Playtest round 2 fixes applied and compiling. Awaiting relaunch verification, then T5 publishing prep.
